EDTHP 115.name: Education in American Society
EDTHP 115.description: Historical, political, philosophical, and sociological forces that have shaped the course of schooling in the United States.

EDTHP 200.name: Educational Reform and Public Policy
EDTHP 200.description: An interdisciplinary approach to exploring the policies and reforms that shape the nation's largest social institution: public schools.

EDTHP 394.name: Professional Development in Education and Public Policy
EDTHP 394.description: Develops professional skills for field placement and future employment, focusing on understanding educational policy across governmental, private, and civic organizations.

EDTHP 395.name: Real-World Policy Experience: Field Placement
EDTHP 395.description: Structures a summer field experience, research project, and service in an off-site educational policy organization.

EDTHP 420.name: Education and Public Policy
EDTHP 420.description: Examines the political process of policy development and implementation, considering how formal policies interact with teaching and learning in U.S. schools. Bulletin also requires 5th-semester standing, which the planner schema does not model directly.
